articles.title: Brazil votes with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro leading the polls
articles.summary: Brazil began voting on 4 October, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro leading the polls. A second round looks likely, but the outcome remains uncertain.

articles.title: Protesters Challenge Trump’s Proposed Arch Near Washington Landmarks
articles.summary: Veterans and lawmakers protested President Trump’s proposed 250-foot arch on October 1. The project faces a lawsuit as federal approval steps continue.

articles.title: Trump visits Ohio to support Husted in close Senate race
articles.summary: Trump’s October 3 visit to Ohio aimed to support Jon Husted in a close Senate race against Sherrod Brown. Living costs and data centers are key issues.
